name: legion-router
description: Legion's registry-driven router: scoped delegation across Claude, Codex, Cursor, opencode, DeepSeek Harness, Hermes, and Pi. Adapters return an isolated-worktree diff and evidence; usage is reported only where the provider publishes a usable contract. Ships `legion-delegate`, executor wrappers, generic GitHub issue intake via `legion-intake`, the loopback :8082 metering proxy, and the shared cost table.
